verdict.rationale: Event-triggered workflows are a fair axis for a workflow orchestration platform, but the evidence shows no connected-app triggers for new records, messages, emails, or form submissions. The Temporal Client's ability to start Workflow Executions and send Signals is a developer building block: a developer would have to write code to wire app events to it. Schedules are time-based, not event-based. Neither counts for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)
